dimension_note: Wheelbase 2.91 m is sourced (7A and 11 Legere). Track 1.34 m front and 1.30 m rear, 0.34 m wheels on 65 mm tyres, and all heights and body dimensions are assumptions.
suspension_note: Front: equal, parallel wishbones 0.40 m long (a parallelogram: the upright keeps its angle and moves on an arc); the torsion bar runs back from the lower arm's pivot to an anchor at the bulkhead, and its twist is the lower arm's hinge spring. The shock absorbers' type is not established; joint damping stands in for them. Rear: a 75 mm tube axle (sourced) on trailing arms 0.55 m long that pivot on a transverse torsion tube; the Panhard rod is not drawn because the model's axle has no sideways freedom.
steering_note: 1934 cars: worm-and-roller box (rack and pinion from May 1936). The linkage layout is assumed: the box on the left rear suspension tower turns a lengthwise sector shaft, so the drop arm swings sideways and its ball moves across the car like a rack; split track rods run from that ball to steering arms behind the wheels, so one wheel's travel acts on its own rod only. Left-hand drive (assumed).
